blocks.text: A Breast Lift, also known as Mastopexy, is a cosmetic breast procedure designed to raise and reshape sagging breasts for a firmer, more youthful appearance. This procedure helps restore breast position, improve symmetry, and enhance natural feminine contours while creating more balanced body proportions.

Pregnancy, breastfeeding, weight changes, aging, and gravity can all contribute to loss of breast firmness and skin elasticity over time. A Breast Lift removes excess skin and reshapes the breast tissue to create a lifted, rejuvenated appearance tailored to your body and aesthetic goals.

At Tampa Bay Body Sculpting, we work with a carefully selected network of Board-Certified Cosmetic Surgeons in Florida experienced in advanced breast enhancement procedures. Every treatment plan is personalized based on your anatomy, desired shape, and overall goals.

blocks.text: Please reach us at info@tampabaybodysculpting.com if you cannot find an answer to your question.

A breast lift, also known as mastopexy, is a surgical procedure that raises and reshapes sagging breasts by removing excess skin and repositioning the breast tissue. The goal is to create a firmer, more youthful breast contour while maintaining natural-looking results.

Women experiencing sagging breasts, loss of firmness, or changes after pregnancy, breastfeeding, aging, or weight loss may be good candidates for a Breast Lift. Ideal candidates are in good overall health and looking to restore a more youthful breast shape.

A breast lift can help improve: Sagging or drooping breasts, Downward-pointing nipples, Loss of breast shape, Stretched skin, Breast asymmetry (in some cases). Every treatment plan is customized to your anatomy and aesthetic goals.
A Breast Lift does involve surgical incisions, and scar placement depends on the technique used and the amount of lifting required. Surgeons aim to place incisions as discreetly as possible.

Most patients experience swelling, soreness, and tightness during the initial recovery period. Many patients return to light daily activities within about one to two weeks, with continued healing over the following weeks.
A breast lift can: Restore a more youthful breast position, Improve breast shape, Correct sagging, Reposition the nipples, Improve breast symmetry, Enhance body proportions, and Increase confidence.
We offer financing options to help make breast lift surgery more affordable. During your consultation, we'll review available payment plans and financing solutions that fit your budget.

Ready to restore a firmer, more youthful breast appearance? Schedule your consultation with Tampa Bay Body Sculpting today. We'll discuss your goals, answer your questions, and develop a personalized treatment plan designed specifically for you.

A breast lift raises and reshapes sagging breasts but does not significantly increase breast size. Breast augmentation increases breast volume using implants or fat transfer. Many patients choose to combine both procedures for fuller, lifted breasts.
Yes. A breast lift is commonly combined with breast augmentation, breast reduction, tummy tuck, Lipo 360, or other body contouring procedures. It is also a popular component of a Mommy Makeover.

A breast lift primarily changes the position and shape of the breasts rather than their size. Some patients feel their breasts appear slightly smaller because excess skin is removed. If you would like more volume, your provider may recommend combining a breast lift with breast augmentation.

Yes. A breast lift requires surgical incisions, so some scarring is expected. Your provider places incisions as strategically as possible, and scars typically fade over time. The exact incision pattern depends on the amount of lifting needed.

Breast sagging can occur naturally over time due to aging, pregnancy, breastfeeding, weight fluctuations, genetics, and the effects of gravity. A breast lift can restore a more youthful breast position and improve overall breast shape without significantly increasing breast size.
